### TC-SCR-21-WEB-038 · Accessibility · WCAG 2.2 AA scan, keyboard and story-specific checks

- **Traces:** SCR-21.STATE.populated
- **Platform:** Web
- **Environment:** Chrome (current) · 1440×900 · staging · axe-core · NVDA
- **Type:** Accessibility · Positive
- **Technique:** Use case
- **Priority:** P2
- **Tier:** regression
- **Role:** Administrator
- **Preconditions:** Signed in as a Administrator test user; #appusers open; seed loaded
- **Test data:** Test data kit from G5 (seed named in test-plan.md)
- **Depends on:** —
- **Decision:** —
- **Steps:**
  1. Run axe-core on #appusers
  2. Traverse the page with Tab / Shift+Tab only
  3. Check: Dialog `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby` the title; initial focus the × button; Esc/backdrop close without returning focus; × and Cancel return focus to the opener; no focus trap.
  4. Check: **Focus after Save.** Add-Save: focus returns to the static **＋ Add App User** button (verified on the running prototype: `BUTTON app-add`). Edit-Save: the table is re-rendered before the dialog closes, so the recorded o
  5. Check: Phone No is `aria-required` with `aria-describedby` to an error paragraph. First Name, Last Name, Earner and Reedemed have no error element at all. Email has one.
  6. Check: Eye toggle has `aria-pressed` and a dynamic aria-label; the ✎ label embeds the full phone (privacy finding).
  7. Check: Table `sr-only` caption "App users". Pagination `nav aria-label="Pagination"`, current page has `aria-current="page"`.
  8. Check: Toast `role="status"` through the live region.
- **Expected:**
  1. Zero serious or critical violations
  2. Every interactive control is reachable in visual order with a visible focus indicator; no keyboard trap
  3. Holds as the story requires: Dialog `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby` the title; initial focus the × button; Esc/backdrop close without returning focus; × and Cancel return focus to the opener; no focus trap.
  4. Holds as the story requires: **Focus after Save.** Add-Save: focus returns to the static **＋ Add App User** button (verified on the running prototype: `BUTTON app-add`). Edit-Save: the table is re-rendered before the dialog closes, so the recorded o
  5. Holds as the story requires: Phone No is `aria-required` with `aria-describedby` to an error paragraph. First Name, Last Name, Earner and Reedemed have no error element at all. Email has one.
  6. Holds as the story requires: Eye toggle has `aria-pressed` and a dynamic aria-label; the ✎ label embeds the full phone (privacy finding).
  7. Holds as the story requires: Table `sr-only` caption "App users". Pagination `nav aria-label="Pagination"`, current page has `aria-current="page"`.
  8. Holds as the story requires: Toast `role="status"` through the live region.
- **Notes:** Related open questions: OQ-21-13.
- **Status:** Not run
- **Actual:** —
- **Evidence:** —
- **Defect:** —
- **Executed:** —
